Katie Couric on Instagram: "President Trump fired Attorney General Pam Bondi on Thursday due to his frustration with her handling of the Epstein files. For now, she will be replaced by Deputy Attorney General Todd Blanche, according to a source familiar with the matter. 

In recent days, Trump talked to allies about his desire to fire Bondi and spoke with her about it on Wednesday. He’s expressed frustration over her not investigating and prosecuting enough of his political opponents. 

CNN reports that Environmental Protection Agency administrator Lee Zeldin is up for consideration as Bondi’s replacement. 

In a Truth Social Post on Thursday afternoon Trump said, “Pam Bondi is a Great American Patriot and a loyal friend, who faithfully served as my Attorney General over the past year. Pam did a tremendous job overseeing a massive crackdown in Crime across our Country, with Murders plummeting to their lowest level since 1900. We love Pam, and she will be transitioning to a much needed and important new job in the private sector, to be announced at a date in the near future, and our Deputy Attorney General, and a very talented and respected Legal Mind, Todd Blanche, will step in to serve as Acting Attorney General. Thank you for your attention to this matter!” 

📷: Getty/Alex Wong"

Thank you for your attention to this matter!” 📷: Getty/Alex WongShe's exempt from NOTHINGS ooo what. She is uneducated lawyerBondi made a total monkey out of herself for Trump. The world saw those hideous performances on TV, precipitated by her undying desire to protect him and his friends and to carry out his unethical and unfounded prosecutions of those he perceived to be his enemies, firing hundreds of career employees who just did their jobs and manufacturing charges against his enemies that were going nowhere to cause maximum pain. Clients ask their attorneys to do crazy things all the time. It is her job, her ethical responsibility, her obligation under her law license, to say no, to quit in response — and many DOJ lawyers who wanted to remain lawyers did just that. She didn’t. She pursued those acts with gusto. For all of that, in my opinion, Bondi should be disbarred. Her reward? The same humiliation accorded to anyone who isn’t dirty enough to be successful despite such an abuse of power. She was fired because we still have a legal system in this country that is still largely impermeable to this kind of abuse. But for all her faults, no other attorney with any integrity can possibly take this job and come out alright on the other end.Can someone file an ethics complaint so she can be disbarredSo he fired her not because of her sheer incompetence and the arrogance of a mediocre person with power but because she did not investigate his opponents?! Well, not that I expected anything better considering her and him. So now they must be looking for the next utterly incompetent one on the food chain. If we go by their track record, don’t expect anything better, look at who replaced puppy killer Noem 🤦‍♀️
